s: Two friends sitting on the floor with their backs against a sofa, two mugs beside them. A young woman with light tan skin and dark wavy hair speaks with red-rimmed eyes and eyebrows pulled up in the middle, one hand pressed flat on her own sternum and the other on her knee. Her friend, a man in his twenties with brown skin and short braids, listens with his whole body turned toward her, eyebrows soft, both of his hands resting on his own knees. Nobody touches the other. Each character has exactly two arms and two hands; every visible hand connects to a visible arm and shoulder that are themselves in frame, with exactly five clearly separated fingers and no extra hand anywhere

A woman in her twenties with pale skin and long chestnut waves glances sideways at a round wall clock, lips parted on a small silent sigh, one hand pressed flat over her stomach, the other arm hugging her own waist, the inner ends of her eyebrows tightening. The clock reads five o'clock exactly: the short hour hand points at the 5 and the long minute hand points straight up at the 12. Single character in frame. Each character has exactly two arms and two hands; every visible hand connects to a visible arm and shoulder that are themselves in frame, with exactly five clearly separated fingers and no extra hand anywhere
